scope: Frozen pure Query E loader for the single pending S1+Query checkpoint

review.shape_bound: dimension<=35, remaining in 2..29, capacity power-of-two<=2^20, four E columns, message n=2^(remaining-2)
review.tasks_formula: ceil(min(capacity,n-first)/32) * ceil(prefixes/256); prefixes=floor((live-(column*n+first)-1)/2^remaining)+1 when first coefficient is live; zero tasks for pad/zero/public-suffix-only block
review.tasks_upper_reason: remaining 2 gives n=1 and prefixes<=2^33, hence 2^25 tasks; remaining>=7 gives at most 2^20 tasks until the capacity cap further reduces them
review.task_indexing: uint64 task/grid-stride; each CTA handles 32 coefficients x 256 prefixes, each of 8 workers per coefficient handles 32 prefixes; all threads reach all three barriers uniformly
review.index_upper: Original index prefix*2^remaining+column*n+first+coefficient <=2^35-1; the index<live guard precedes packed_address and every W read
review.ordinary_scan_work: Across four columns/all normal blocks, every live W coefficient is visited once and yields all three components; prefix parallelization does not add a W scan or an A reconstruction
review.per_task_bounds: 8192 signed W reads, 256 checked EQ cache entries, 96 nonzero field-add requests at most; CAS retry count is not bounded here
review.launch_accounting: Weights: attempted1 for init, plus1 iff tasks>0; failures retain actual attempts. Resident path unchanged at one launch

pinned_last_extension.note: Earlier scalar layout had only 64 useful W threads per column, each looping through 119911505 reads. This is analytic work/capacity, not a CUDA benchmark or hardware speedup

review.parity_fixture: Independent unsigned128 Goldilocks convolution with v^3=v+1, dense MSB folds, new lane/worker/CTA/grid-stride emulation, 190 cases/189 complete logical passes/3024 Horner checks; prefix tile crossings, ragged mapping, signed marker, zero EQ, canonicality, pads and public suffix
review.remaining: Root serial validation, combined owner/Rust guards and exact full chain, complete joint lifetime census; no compilation or H100 claims from this preparation
